$comment.loading: ⭐ DISTINCT FROM THE EMPTY COPY, AND THE DISTINCTION IS LOAD-BEARING (AC6). Showing 'your Pariwar has not run a drive yet' while the first read is still in flight would assert something FALSE about the member's own Pariwar. The three states — loading, empty, error — are separately reachable and separately announced.
empty: Your Pariwar has not run a drive yet. When one opens, it will appear here.
$comment.empty: ⭐ It REPORTS STATE and never attributes responsibility — the `contributor_list.empty` register. ⛔ An empty list is not a failure and must not read as one.
error: We could not load the drives just now. Please try again in a moment.
$comment.error: ⚠⛔ THIS STATE IS REACHABLE, AND KEEPING IT REACHABLE IS A DESIGN DECISION. The read route is deliberately NOT fail-soft: were it to degrade to an empty list, this copy would be unreachable and the member would be told their Pariwar has run no drives when the truth is that we could not load them. ⛔ Never blame the member or their connection — we could not load it.
$comment.district: ⭐ An honest absence, ⛔ never a blank cell. `district` is null when the deceased member has no posting row.
$comment.row_a11y: ⭐ THE ROW'S ACCESSIBLE NAME (AC5, family 13). ⚠ It states the SAME facts the row renders visually — it is a grouping label, ⛔ never extra information a sighted member cannot reach. ⛔ `t()` THROWS on an unsupplied token: supply ALL FOUR.
$comment.row_a11y_no_family: ⚠⛔ THE VARIANT IS WHAT STOPS A CRASH, ⛔ not a nicety. `deceasedMemberName` is nullable on the wire (a drive whose family name is unresolvable), and `t()` THROWS on an unsupplied token ⇒ resolving `row.a11y` there would take down the WHOLE list, not one row. ⭐ Same structural reason `sahyog-shared` ships `zero_line.no_family`. $comment.loading_more: [Review][Patch] — code review of 11b-15-member-drive-list-fourth-tab (2026-09-09), THIRD pass, family 13(d).
